test_period_range_freq_asi8: test that period_range generates correct asi8 integer values for various frequencies like W-THU, D, B, h, min, s, ms, us, ns, M, Y
test_period_index_tolist_conversion: test that PeriodIndex.tolist() returns a list of Period objects that round-trip correctly through PeriodIndex constructor
test_period_range_base_date_mapping: test that period_range maps base_date correctly per frequency, using calendar dates for sub-daily freqs and year-month for M, year integer for Y
test_period_index_asi8_sequence: test that asi8 property of a PeriodIndex produces a contiguous int64 array starting from zero for a range of periods
test_period_roundtrip_serialization: test that a PeriodIndex can be converted to a Python list and reconstructed back into an equivalent PeriodIndex
